title.value: Better Quality Pretraining Data and T5 Models for African Languages
title.justification: The title clearly mentions the focus on pretraining data quality and model development for African languages.
title.quote: Better Quality Pretraining Data and T5 Models for African Languages

extractions.description: This paper discusses the importance of enhancing the quality of pretraining data in multilingual language models, particularly for low-resource African languages. It introduces a new multilingual pretraining corpus for 16 African languages by auditing and improving existing corpora. The new T5-based model demonstrates superior performance in NLP tasks, highlighting the role of data quality in pretraining language models.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper is primarily centered on improving multilingual pretraining data and models for African languages and does not explicitly focus on climate or ecological sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: In this study, we highlight the importance of enhancing the quality of pretraining data in multilingual language models.

primary_category.justification: The content of the paper does not directly address any Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development categories.
primary_category.quote: Existing web crawls have demonstrated quality issues, particularly in the context of low-resource languages.

primary_sub_category.quote: Our model demonstrates better downstream effectiveness over existing pretrained models across four NLP tasks.
